$Comment: The Horseman's Head on the hard ride: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Head written out again, as the game writes its own hard bosses, with more health, a bomb every 2.5 to 3 seconds and the Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Hard_Mode effect, which makes its bombs hit harder.
